comment: Firing alerts in plain words, one set for the Controller web Fleet page and `vonkctl fleet`. The web test renders the Fleet page and compares each alert item's DOM text; the vonkctl test runs the fleet overview and compares the alert lines it prints (the Sparks' own notes follow them). Both must equal `expected` exactly. This file is also the one owner of the unavailable sentence. The alerts named in deploy/compose/prometheus/alerts.yaml carry that file's summaries verbatim.

alerts.name: NodeAgentStale
alerts.summary: An active Vonk Forge node is offline; a running agent keeps retrying on its own

alerts.name: ControlDatabaseUnavailable
alerts.summary: The control API or its database dependency is unavailable

expected: Warning: An active Vonk Forge node is offline; a running agent keeps retrying on its own (Spark Two)
Critical: The control API or its database dependency is unavailable
Warning: A node left the fleet (spk_99999999999999999999999999999999)
